capabilities: Translate selected text through a local LibreTranslate API
Save words to a vocabulary notebook with definitions, synonyms, phonetics, and CEFR levels
Browse, search, sort, and paginate saved words
Import and export the vocabulary as JSON for backup
Assign hotkeys for translating, looking up, and saving words
extras: The README is bilingual (Chinese and English); LibreTranslate must be deployed separately, with a Docker one-command deployment documented.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in translation, and cloud translators send text to third-party services instead of a local one.

relations.evidence: This plugin depends on LibreTranslate translation service. Please ensure it is deployed and running.

summary: Translation and vocabulary plugin that translates selected text via a self-hosted LibreTranslate API and manages a personal word notebook.
